name: arena-live-mastra
description: Live arena adapter: Mastra (TypeScript/Node AI framework, Apache-2.0) driven against the real agnes-2.0-flash model via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Exhaustive multi-mode stdin/stdout adapter (qa, rag, tools, memory, memory_scoped, isolation_leak, crash_recovery, structured, stream, observability) for the aisotropy arena harness, exercising Mastra native features (Agent, Memory, tools, structured output, streaming, native OpenTelemetry) against real infra (agnes chat, e5 embeddings, Qdrant, rqlite, libsql).
